text:
priya: Quick check — we saw a TTFT spike last night for hosted-api (prod). I want the canonical place to look at p50/p95/p99 + tokens/sec and any tracing pointers. Also: are the TTFT alerts too noisy right now?

sean: Dashboard to use: https://grafana.internal.redwood.com/d/ttft_overview — it has a combined view (p50/p95/p99 by model) and a tokens/sec heatmap. Panels to jump to: 
- TTFT by model (panel 2)
- Tokens/sec (panel 7)
- Request rate & error rate (panel 4)

matt: PromQL we usually run for p95: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="redwood-api",env="prod"}[5m])) by (le, model))
```
For tokens/sec: 
```
sum(rate(tokens_processed_total{env="prod"}[1m])) by (model)
```
Plug the `model` label to filter.

priya: thanks — for traces, is Jaeger the right place? I need an example trace to attach to the incident notes.

rafael: Yes, Jaeger works. Search by service=api + time window or paste a trace id from the Grafana hover. Link: https://jaeger.internal.redwood.com/search?service=api&lookback=1h
If you want a quick sample trace, grab the trace id from the TTFT panel -> click `open trace`.

obs-bot: Alert fired: `TTFT_p95_high (prod)` — labels: model=gpt-medium, region=us-west — count=6 in last 10m.

sean: I saw a burst tied to a tenant job — tokens/sec peaked. Could be a dedicated pool autoscale thundering. We should decide: tune alert threshold or add suppression during deploys. @matt any preference?

matt: I'm inclined to loosen the threshold slightly for gpt-medium and add a short silence window when we detect rolling deploys. I'll put up a PR to change the alert from `> 1.2s` to `> 1.5s` for that model and add a `for: 15m` guard so transient blips don't spam. PR: https://git.internal.redwood.com/redwood/observability/pulls/452

priya: pinging for review — this should reduce noise while we investigate autoscale behavior.

erik: I'll review in ~30m and run the alert rule locally against last 24h to sanity-check false-positive rate.

matt: For the alert rule, here's the snippet I'm proposing (Prometheus alert):
```yaml
alert: TTFT_p95_high
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="redwood-api",env="prod"}[5m])) by (le, model)) > 1.5
for: 15m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "TTFT p95 > 1.5s (prod) for {{ $labels.model }}"
  runbook: https://playbooks.internal.redwood.com/ttft-p95
```

priya: Nice. Also can we add KV cache hit rate + tokens/sec per-route to the dashboard? That would help correlate cache misses to token churn.

sean: Agree. I created an issue: https://app.internal.redwood.com/issue/OBS-987 — add tokens/sec by route, kvcache_hit_rate panel, and a trace link column in the TTFT table.

matt: After PR merges I'll add the new panels to the `ttft_overview` dashboard and tag you both.

priya: perfect, thanks everyone :thumbsup:

sean: FYI — if anyone needs to replay the spike locally, use this query to list top routes by tokens in the spike window: 
```
topk(10, sum(rate(tokens_processed_total{env="prod"}[1m])) by (route))
```

priya: copied. I'll grab a trace and attach to the incident notes. If we still see repeats after tuning alerts we can open a postmortem.

obs-bot: Alert `TTFT_p95_high` status: silenced for model=gpt-medium (auto-silence applied by PR 452)

matt: merging PR now. I'll follow up in the issue with panel ids and dashboards changed.

erik: reviewed + lgtm.

priya: thanks all — feel free to @me if you want help validating the dashboard changes in prod.
